name_en: Identify and document a lawful basis for each processing purpose
name_ar: تحديد الأساس القانوني لكل غرض من أغراض المعالجة وتوثيقه
en: ROPA register showing lawful-basis column per processing activity; legal-basis assessment memo signed by DPO or legal counsel; board/management approval record where consent is not the chosen basis

name_en: Obtain and record valid, granular consent
name_ar: الحصول على الموافقة الصريحة والمحددة وتسجيلها
en: Time-stamped consent capture logs (digital form, click-to-accept records, or signed paper forms); consent version linked to privacy notice version; separate consent tick-boxes per processing purpose; evidence that consent was not bundled with terms of service

name_en: Enable withdrawal of consent and cease processing upon request
name_ar: إتاحة سحب الموافقة ووقف المعالجة فور الطلب
en: Withdrawal-of-consent records with timestamps; self-service opt-out mechanism screenshot or audit trail; evidence of processing cessation within the prescribed period; updated consent log reflecting withdrawal

name_en: Legitimate-interest assessment (LIA) where that basis is relied upon
name_ar: تقييم المصلحة المشروعة عند الاستناد إليها أساساً للمعالجة
en: Completed LIA template covering purpose, necessity, and balancing test; sign-off record by DPO; documentation confirming data subject interests were weighed and not overridden

name_en: Publish a comprehensive privacy notice covering all PDPL-required elements
name_ar: نشر إشعار خصوصية شامل يغطي جميع العناصر المطلوبة نظاماً
en: Current published privacy notice (Arabic primary + English); version history and effective dates; checklist confirming coverage of: controller identity, DPO contact, purposes, legal bases, retention schedule, data subject rights, cross-border transfer details, complaint mechanism

name_en: Deliver layered, just-in-time privacy information at point of collection
name_ar: تقديم معلومات الخصوصية الطبقية في لحظة جمع البيانات
en: Screenshots or design specifications showing layered notice implementation (short notice + link to full notice); user-journey documentation confirming notice is presented before or at point of data collection; A/B or UX test records if available

name_en: Maintain a notice version log and notify subjects of material changes
name_ar: الاحتفاظ بسجل إصدارات الإشعار وإبلاغ أصحاب البيانات بالتغييرات الجوهرية
en: Privacy-notice version control log with change descriptions and publication dates; evidence of subject notification (email, in-app message, re-consent prompt) for material changes; sign-off record confirming legal/DPO review before each new version

name_en: Provide privacy information in Arabic as the primary language
name_ar: توفير معلومات الخصوصية باللغة العربية بوصفها اللغة الأساسية
en: Arabic-language version of all public-facing privacy notices and consent forms; linguistic review certification by a qualified Arabic legal-language reviewer; evidence that the Arabic version is at least as prominent as any English version

name_en: Right of access — respond to subject access requests (SARs) within statutory period
name_ar: حق الاطلاع — الاستجابة لطلبات الوصول خلال المدة النظامية
en: DSR intake register with date-received and date-closed columns; SLA compliance report showing response within 30 days (extendable to 60 days with notification); sample redacted SAR responses; identity-verification procedure documentation; log of requests refused and stated reasons

name_en: Right of rectification — correct inaccurate or incomplete personal data
name_ar: حق التصحيح — تصحيح البيانات غير الدقيقة أو الناقصة
en: DSR register entries marked as rectification requests; evidence of data correction in source systems with before/after comparison (where permissible to share); notification records sent to third parties where data was disclosed prior to correction; response-time SLA report

name_en: Right of erasure — delete personal data upon request where no retention obligation applies
name_ar: حق الحذف — مسح البيانات الشخصية عند انتفاء المسوّغ القانوني للاحتفاظ بها
en: DSR register entries marked as erasure requests; evidence of data deletion or anonymisation in source systems; retention-obligation assessment memo where erasure is refused; notification records to processors instructed to delete; erasure certificates where available

name_en: Right of portability — provide personal data in machine-readable format
name_ar: حق نقل البيانات — تسليم البيانات الشخصية بصيغة قابلة للقراءة الآلية
en: DSR register entries marked as portability requests; exported data package samples (JSON or CSV); evidence of response within 30 days; procedure documentation for portability workflow including identity verification and format options offered

name_en: Right to object to processing and to opt out of direct marketing
name_ar: حق الاعتراض على المعالجة والرفض للتسويق المباشر
en: Objection-request log with grounds stated and outcomes recorded; marketing opt-out mechanism screenshots and confirmation emails; evidence that processing ceased following upheld objection; procedure for evaluating compelling legitimate-interest grounds where raised

name_en: DSR process governance — intake, verification, tracking, and escalation
name_ar: حوكمة معالجة طلبات أصحاب البيانات — الاستقبال والتحقق والتتبع والتصعيد
en: Published DSR submission channel (web form, email, or portal) with Arabic-language option; identity-verification procedure documentation; DSR tracker showing open, in-progress, and closed status with responsible owner; escalation matrix for complex or disputed requests; annual DSR volume and SLA-compliance management report

name_en: Maintain a comprehensive ROPA covering all mandatory fields
name_ar: الاحتفاظ بسجل شامل لأنشطة المعالجة يغطي جميع الحقول الإلزامية
en: ROPA register export (spreadsheet or GRC system report) including: processing purpose, lawful basis, data categories, data subject categories, recipients, cross-border transfers, retention period, security measures reference, processor details; dated and version-controlled

name_en: Keep the ROPA current — review upon new processing activity or material change
name_ar: تحديث سجل أنشطة المعالجة باستمرار عند بدء نشاط جديد أو إجراء تغيير جوهري
en: ROPA change-management log showing date of update, nature of change, and approver; new-system intake checklist requiring ROPA update before go-live; periodic ROPA completeness review record signed by DPO or privacy lead; version history showing at least annual formal review

name_en: Make the ROPA available to SDAIA upon request
name_ar: إتاحة سجل أنشطة المعالجة لهيئة البيانات والذكاء الاصطناعي عند الطلب
en: Designated ROPA custodian and access procedure documentation; evidence that the ROPA is held in a format exportable within a reasonable timeframe; prior SDAIA inspection response record if applicable; access-control log confirming DPO has read/export rights to the ROPA

name_en: Conduct a DPIA for all high-risk processing activities before commencement
name_ar: إجراء تقييم أثر حماية البيانات قبل البدء في أي نشاط معالجة عالي الخطورة
en: DPIA screening register identifying all processing activities assessed for high-risk triggers; completed DPIA reports for triggered activities covering: systematic description, necessity/proportionality assessment, risk identification, mitigating measures; DPO sign-off records; board or senior management approval where residual risk is high

name_en: Document DPIA outcomes, residual risks, and agreed mitigating measures
name_ar: توثيق نتائج تقييم الأثر والمخاطر المتبقية وتدابير التخفيف المعتمدة
en: DPIA final report with residual-risk rating and treatment plan; risk register entries cross-referenced to DPIA findings; evidence of implemented controls (e.g., pseudonymisation, access restriction); post-implementation review record confirming control effectiveness

name_en: Consult SDAIA prior to processing where high residual risk cannot be mitigated
name_ar: التشاور مع الهيئة قبل المعالجة حين لا يمكن تخفيف المخاطر العالية المتبقية
en: Prior-consultation request to SDAIA with DPIA report attached; SDAIA response or acknowledgement record; evidence that processing was delayed pending regulatory consultation outcome; board decision record on whether to proceed following SDAIA guidance

name_en: Maintain a DPIA register and schedule periodic reviews for ongoing high-risk processing
name_ar: الاحتفاظ بسجل تقييمات الأثر وجدولة مراجعات دورية للأنشطة العالية الخطورة المستمرة
en: DPIA register index with processing activity, DPIA date, next-review date, and status; review records for DPIAs older than two years or where processing has materially changed; DPO attestation that the DPIA register is complete and current

name_en: Detect, log, and assess all actual and suspected personal data breaches
name_ar: اكتشاف جميع خروقات البيانات الشخصية الفعلية والمشتبه بها وتسجيلها وتقييمها
en: Breach register with: incident date, discovery date, data types affected, number of subjects, breach category, and initial risk assessment; detection-to-awareness timeline evidence; internal escalation records to DPO and legal counsel within 24 hours of discovery; investigation report documenting cause and scope

name_en: Notify SDAIA within 72 hours for breaches posing risk to data subjects
name_ar: إخطار الهيئة خلال 72 ساعة للخروقات التي تشكّل خطراً على أصحاب البيانات
en: SDAIA breach notification submission record (portal reference number or email acknowledgement); notification timestamp proving 72-hour compliance; notification content covering: nature of breach, categories and approximate number of affected records and subjects, DPO contact, likely consequences, measures taken or proposed; where notification was delayed beyond 72 hours, documented reasons

name_en: Notify affected data subjects without undue delay for high-risk breaches
name_ar: إخطار أصحاب البيانات المتضررين دون تأخير غير مبرر للخروقات عالية الخطورة
en: Data subject notification records (email send logs, SMS delivery receipts, or posted-letter proof); notification content evidence covering: plain-language description, DPO contact, likely consequences, protective steps subjects should take; SDAIA consultation record where notification was waived; subject-notification timeline evidence

name_en: Maintain a breach register and conduct post-incident review
name_ar: الاحتفاظ بسجل الخروقات وإجراء مراجعة ما بعد الحادثة
en: Cumulative breach register accessible to DPO and senior management; post-incident review report for each significant breach covering root cause, lessons learned, and preventive actions; evidence of preventive actions implemented; annual breach trend analysis report

name_en: Identify and document all cross-border personal data transfers
name_ar: تحديد جميع عمليات نقل البيانات الشخصية عبر الحدود وتوثيقها
en: Cross-border transfer inventory mapped from ROPA; destination country list with adequacy status classification; processor/sub-processor country-of-operation records; data-flow diagram showing international flows; annual transfer inventory review record

name_en: Conduct a transfer risk assessment (TRA) for each destination jurisdiction
name_ar: إجراء تقييم مخاطر النقل لكل ولاية قضائية مقصودة
en: Completed TRA per destination country or processor covering: local legal framework adequacy, government-access risk, technical safeguards in place, and overall risk rating; SDAIA adequacy determination check record (published list); DPO approval memo for each TRA; date of last review and trigger for next review

name_en: Implement and document an approved transfer mechanism for non-adequate destinations
name_ar: تطبيق آلية نقل معتمدة وتوثيقها للوجهات غير الكافية
en: Signed data transfer agreements (standard contractual clauses approved by SDAIA, or binding corporate rules); SDAIA approval or registration records where required; evidence that contractual clauses are reflected in operational practice; supplementary technical measures documentation (encryption, pseudonymisation)

name_en: Apply and document recognised transfer exceptions where relied upon
name_ar: تطبيق استثناءات النقل المعترف بها وتوثيقها عند الاستناد إليها
en: Exception-reliance register documenting which exception applies (explicit consent, contractual necessity, vital interests, public interest), the factual basis, and frequency of use; legal opinion or DPO assessment confirming exception conditions are met; evidence that exceptions are not used systematically as a substitute for a proper transfer mechanism

name_en: Monitor changes to SDAIA adequacy determinations and update transfer arrangements accordingly
name_ar: متابعة تحديثات قرارات الكفاءة الصادرة عن الهيئة وتحديث ترتيبات النقل وفقاً لذلك
en: Documented process for monitoring SDAIA adequacy-list updates; change log showing transfer-mechanism updates triggered by adequacy decisions; evidence of processor notification where transfer arrangements are affected; annual transfer compliance review signed by DPO

name_en: Apply data minimisation — collect only data necessary for the specified purpose
name_ar: تطبيق مبدأ تقليل البيانات — جمع ما هو ضروري فحسب للغرض المحدد
en: Data-collection field inventory mapped to processing purpose with necessity justification per field; privacy-by-design review record for new systems confirming minimisation applied; periodic data-catalogue audit showing redundant or excess fields identified and removed

name_en: Maintain data accuracy and provide correction mechanisms
name_ar: الحفاظ على دقة البيانات وتوفير آليات التصحيح
en: Data-quality policy and periodic data-quality audit reports; evidence of proactive accuracy checks (e.g., annual profile update prompts sent to customers); DSR rectification-request log demonstrating operational correction process; data-quality KPI dashboard extract

name_en: Maintain and implement a formal retention schedule for all personal data categories
name_ar: وضع جدول احتفاظ رسمي بجميع فئات البيانات الشخصية وتطبيقه
en: Approved retention schedule document covering all personal data categories with retention periods, legal/regulatory basis for each period, and deletion trigger; evidence of annual retention schedule review and DPO/legal sign-off; record of retention schedule being communicated to data custodians

name_en: Execute secure, verifiable disposal of personal data at end of retention period
name_ar: تنفيذ إتلاف آمن وقابل للتحقق للبيانات الشخصية عند انتهاء فترة الاحتفاظ
en: Automated or scheduled data-deletion job run logs; secure-disposal certificates from data custodians and processors; evidence of physical media destruction (certificates from vendor); annual disposal compliance report cross-referencing retention schedule; anonymisation audit trail where deletion is replaced by anonymisation

name_en: Identify and inventory all sensitive personal data categories processed
name_ar: تحديد جميع فئات البيانات الشخصية الحساسة المعالَجة وحصرها
en: Sensitive-data inventory derived from ROPA; classification matrix mapping data types to PDPL sensitive categories (health, genetic, biometric, financial, criminal, religious/political); data-classification labelling evidence in systems handling sensitive data; DPO attestation of inventory completeness

name_en: Establish a specific lawful basis or explicit consent for each sensitive data processing activity
name_ar: تحديد أساس قانوني خاص أو موافقة صريحة لكل نشاط معالجة للبيانات الحساسة
en: Sensitive-data processing register showing lawful basis or explicit-consent record per activity; explicit-consent capture logs distinct from general processing consent; legal opinion or SDAIA guidance relied upon for statutory-basis processing; DPO sign-off on all sensitive-data processing justifications

name_en: Apply enhanced security and access controls to sensitive personal data
name_ar: تطبيق ضمانات أمنية مشددة وضوابط وصول على البيانات الحساسة
en: Access-control matrix showing sensitive data accessible only to role-justified users; encryption-at-rest and in-transit evidence for sensitive data stores; segregation evidence (sensitive data in separate schemas or encrypted fields); access log review records; penetration test scope confirmation that sensitive data stores are covered

name_en: Conduct a DPIA before commencing large-scale or novel sensitive data processing
name_ar: إجراء تقييم أثر حماية البيانات قبل البدء في معالجة واسعة النطاق أو جديدة للبيانات الحساسة
en: DPIA screening record confirming sensitive-data trigger was assessed; completed DPIA report for large-scale or novel sensitive processing; evidence of mitigating measures implemented; DPO and senior management approval records

name_en: Obtain verified parental or guardian consent before processing children's personal data
name_ar: الحصول على موافقة وليّ الأمر الموثقة قبل معالجة بيانات القاصرين
en: Age-verification mechanism documentation and audit trail; parental/guardian consent capture logs with identity-verification step evidence; under-18 user flag in data systems; procedure for handling data collected before age verification where applicable; child-specific privacy notice in age-appropriate language

name_en: Restrict health data processing to authorised medical or insurance purposes with strict access controls
name_ar: تقييد معالجة البيانات الصحية على الأغراض الطبية أو التأمينية المعتمدة مع ضوابط وصول صارمة
en: Health data processing purpose register with statutory or explicit-consent basis per entry; role-based access control evidence limiting health data to clinical/insurance roles; audit logs for health data access and export; data-sharing agreement with any healthcare provider or insurer receiving health data; professional confidentiality policy

name_en: Process credit and financial data only under regulated-purpose basis with consumer protection safeguards
name_ar: معالجة البيانات الائتمانية والمالية في نطاق الأغراض النظامية مع ضمانات حماية المستهلك
en: Credit-data processing register linked to SAMA/SIMAH authorisation or contractual necessity basis; data-sharing agreements with SIMAH or other credit bureaus; consumer dispute and correction process documentation; evidence that credit data is not used for purposes beyond credit assessment; annual credit-data audit report

name_en: Process genetic data only for expressly permitted purposes under heightened security
name_ar: معالجة البيانات الجينية فقط للأغراض المصرح بها صراحةً وبأعلى مستوى من الضمانات الأمنية
en: Genetic data processing justification memo citing specific statutory permission or explicit consent; evidence of encryption and pseudonymisation applied to genetic datasets; access restricted to qualified researchers or clinicians with documented need-to-know; ethics committee or IRB approval record where processing is for research

name_en: Designate a qualified DPO and register with SDAIA where required
name_ar: تعيين مسؤول حماية بيانات مؤهل وتسجيله لدى الهيئة حيثما اشترط النظام
en: DPO appointment letter or board resolution; DPO qualifications and certification evidence (CIPP/ME or equivalent); SDAIA registration or notification record; DPO contact published in privacy notice; evidence that the DPO is not in a conflict of interest with other duties

name_en: Ensure DPO independence, authority, and access to senior management
name_ar: ضمان استقلالية مسؤول حماية البيانات وصلاحياته ووصوله إلى الإدارة العليا
en: Organisational chart showing DPO reporting line (directly to board or CEO level); DPO mandate/charter document confirming independence from business units; evidence of DPO attendance at senior management or board meetings; record of DPO advisory opinions sought and considered on high-risk decisions

name_en: Assign DPO tasks formally and provide sufficient resources
name_ar: تحديد مهام مسؤول حماية البيانات رسمياً وتزويده بالموارد الكافية
en: DPO job description covering all PDPL-mandated tasks (monitoring compliance, DPIA advisory, SDAIA liaison, data-subject rights, training); evidence of dedicated time allocation; DPO annual work plan and activity log; training budget allocation record; evidence of DPO participation in industry forums or continuing professional development

name_en: Establish a privacy governance framework — policies, procedures, and accountability structure
name_ar: إرساء إطار حوكمة الخصوصية — السياسات والإجراءات وهيكل المساءلة
en: Approved data protection policy suite (privacy policy, data retention policy, breach response procedure, DSR procedure, DPIA procedure, third-party management policy); board approval records; annual privacy governance review minutes; privacy risk inclusion in enterprise risk register; privacy training completion records for all staff handling personal data

name_en: Conduct due-diligence assessments of processors before engagement
name_ar: إجراء تقييم العناية الواجبة للمعالجين قبل التعاقد معهم
en: Processor due-diligence questionnaire and completed assessment records; security certification evidence (ISO 27001, SOC 2, or equivalent) for critical processors; DPO sign-off on processor assessments; annual processor risk-review schedule and records; registry of approved processors with risk ratings

name_en: Execute a PDPL-compliant data processing agreement (DPA) with every processor
name_ar: إبرام اتفاقية معالجة بيانات متوافقة مع نظام حماية البيانات مع كل معالج
en: Signed DPA inventory covering all processors; DPA template review record confirming coverage of: processing scope and purpose, data subject categories, security obligations, sub-processor approval requirement, breach notification to controller, data return/deletion at termination, audit rights; legal counsel review record of DPA template

name_en: Manage and authorise sub-processor arrangements
name_ar: إدارة ترتيبات معالجي الباطن والموافقة عليها
en: Sub-processor register derived from processor disclosures; evidence of controller authorisation (general or specific) for sub-processor use; flow-down DPA or equivalent contractual obligations with sub-processors; notification log when processors appoint new sub-processors; annual sub-processor inventory review

name_en: Monitor processor compliance and exercise audit rights periodically
name_ar: متابعة امتثال المعالجين وممارسة حقوق التدقيق بصفة دورية
en: Annual processor compliance review records (questionnaire, audit, or third-party assurance report); evidence of follow-up on non-conformances identified; processor audit-right clause in DPA; record of exercised audit visits or inspection letters for high-risk processors; processor incident/breach notification log

name_en: Obtain and document marketing consent; maintain suppression lists
name_ar: الحصول على موافقة التسويق وتوثيقها؛ الاحتفاظ بقوائم الإلغاء
en: Marketing opt-in consent records linked to campaign CRM; suppression/do-not-contact list evidence; unsubscribe mechanism audit trail confirming removal from lists within required period; evidence that suppression list is applied across all marketing channels; annual marketing-database hygiene audit

name_en: Comply with the Communications and Information Technology Commission (CITC) anti-spam obligations
name_ar: الامتثال لاشتراطات هيئة الاتصالات وتقنية المعلومات المتعلقة بمكافحة البريد الإلكتروني غير المرغوب فيه
en: CITC anti-spam policy compliance checklist; unsubscribe link presence in all commercial emails; sender identification in all SMS/email marketing; evidence of opt-in prior to first commercial communication; record of complaints received and handled

name_en: Implement safeguards and transparency for automated individual decision-making
name_ar: اعتماد ضمانات وشفافية لصنع القرار الآلي الفردي
en: Automated decision-making register identifying all processes producing significant effects; privacy notice disclosure covering automated decision-making logic in plain language; evidence of human-review mechanism for data subjects affected by automated decisions; DPIA record for automated decision-making activities; algorithmic bias monitoring report where applicable

name_en: Prohibit processing for profiling or targeted advertising without appropriate basis
name_ar: حظر استخدام البيانات للتحديد النوعي أو الإعلان المستهدف دون أساس قانوني مناسب
en: Data-use purpose register confirming advertising/profiling activities have an identified lawful basis; consent records where consent is the basis for profiling; LIA documentation where legitimate interest is claimed; evidence of opt-out mechanism for interest-based advertising; periodic review of third-party advertising-technology partners' data use

name_en: Implement risk-appropriate technical security measures for personal data
name_ar: اعتماد تدابير أمنية تقنية متناسبة مع المخاطر لحماية البيانات الشخصية
en: Information security policy approved by senior management; encryption standard documentation covering data at rest and in transit; access-control matrix with least-privilege principle applied; annual penetration test report with personal-data scope confirmed; vulnerability management programme evidence; network segmentation diagram isolating personal data stores

name_en: Implement organisational security measures — training, policies, and access management
name_ar: اعتماد تدابير أمنية تنظيمية — التدريب والسياسات وإدارة الوصول
en: Annual data protection training completion records for all staff; security-awareness programme evidence; background check records for staff with privileged access; access provisioning/de-provisioning log; leavers' process documentation confirming access removed promptly; clean-desk and clear-screen policy implementation evidence

name_en: Embed privacy by design and by default in new systems and projects
name_ar: دمج الخصوصية بالتصميم والافتراض في الأنظمة والمشاريع الجديدة
en: Privacy-by-design checklist integrated into SDLC or project management gate process; evidence of privacy review at design and build phases of at least two recent projects; default privacy settings documentation showing most privacy-protective settings as default; DPO sign-off at project go-live gate

name_en: Maintain accountability documentation and demonstrate compliance to SDAIA on request
name_ar: الاحتفاظ بوثائق المساءلة وإثبات الامتثال للهيئة عند الطلب
en: Compliance programme documentation index (policies, ROPA, DPIAs, DPO appointment, training records, breach register, processor DPAs, transfer assessments); evidence that documents are version-controlled and retrievable; record of any SDAIA inspection or enquiry and response; annual privacy compliance report presented to board or audit committee

name_en: Conduct an annual internal privacy audit and address findings
name_ar: إجراء تدقيق خصوصية داخلي سنوي ومعالجة النتائج
en: Annual internal or third-party privacy audit scope and methodology document; audit report with findings rated by severity; remediation plan with owners and target dates; evidence of findings closure; audit report presented to DPO, senior management, and audit committee; trend analysis comparing successive annual audit findings
